source: GitHub public GraphQL API through the authenticated gh client

inclusion.pullRequests: Merged pull requests whose mergedAt falls inside the exact window
inclusion.issues: Closed non-PR issues whose closedAt falls inside the exact window
inclusion.releases: Repository releases whose publishedAt (or createdAt fallback) falls inside the exact window

caveats: PR counts include release, promotion, propagation, and automation PRs and must not be read as independent features.
Line and file totals are gross GitHub PR metrics; generated files, lockfiles, and overlapping release propagation can inflate them.
Public GitHub data cannot reveal private planning, rejected candidates, unattended runtime, or the amount of human and Agent time.
